run_reward_model_scoring: run the reward model to score RAG responses using Skywork-Reward-Gemma-2-27B and write scores to an output file
run_main_with_system_message: run the main function with a system message added to each user prompt for reward model scoring
run_reward_model_on_custom_data: run the reward model on a custom JSONL data file with a specified number of retrieved documents

review_get_score_function: review the get_score inner function that computes a scalar reward score from tokenized input
